d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Ecuador vs Korea Republic in Group B of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Korea Republic held on for a 3-2 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha after own goals from Carlos Medina and Jhon Chica and a Nam Ian strike put them 3-0 up, before Steven Guerrero and Luis Fragozo struck late for Ecuador. Korea Republic top Group B with nine points, while Ecuador must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
